response.justification: Bogdan brings 14+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile and embedded, a CS degree, and credible high-throughput systems work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby (millions of HTTP requests per second), plus demonstrated mentorship and community teaching. However, the resume shows essentially no experience with the core domain of this role: experimentation platforms, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, or growth measurement. Scope is also mostly team-level product delivery rather than the multi-workstream, cross-org architectural leadership expected at Principal/IC6, and there is little evidence of owning globally distributed, multi-region high-availability services. A reasonable candidate for a senior/staff full-stack or platform role, but a stretch for this specific principal-level growth/experimentation position unless a screen surfaces unlisted A/B testing and metrics work.
strengths: 14+ years of experience with strong engineering fundamentals, TDD/CI/CD craftsmanship, and a CS degree
Proven low-latency, high-volume microservices work (millions of requests/sec) plus polyglot depth across C/C++, Java, C#, TypeScript, D
Track record of building reusable tooling, frameworks, and open-source platforms, plus mentoring via workshops and courses
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or bias/rollout-risk experience
Little evidence of telemetry, metrics infrastructure, or statistical/data-analysis aptitude
Scope and title history (senior/staff, small teams) fall short of Principal-level cross-org, multi-workstream leadership

key_factors.factor: Breadth and depth of engineering experience
